Laundry Service System

(Software Application)
Software
Language

About

This Software Application was developed in 2021. The system is designed for a laundry business. When a customer sends clothes for laundry, the staff can record how many items the customer wants to have washed. This helps calculate the total cost of the laundry service and provides a receipt for the customer. The system also includes a table where staff can monitor how many customers have already submitted laundry.

User Demo

Staff User

The Staff User is responsible for entering customer laundry information, checking who has submitted laundry and who has paid, and viewing the receipts.
